bestBets.overview: Some showers about, nothing of biblical proportions but could be enough to keep the track rated soft. Kick the seven race card off with a 1680m Maiden. Map says 3 leads and 2 stalks, next in line not so certain.  I'd like to think we've reached the point where one say MOSCOW MULE ain't no mule, someone with naming rights sure has proved to be a jinx. File all of that under 'careful what you wish for'. All that remains to be seen is whether the rise from 1350m to 1680m is premature but on the score of ability/promise this mule should be a hard to beat racehorse. LOTTERY LINK and ISLA DELILAH look to be the obvious dangers, even without considering their significant map advantage. WINGEANDWIN next best (rider may only claim 1/2 of his 1 1/2???).

raceTips.comment: We race at Ipswich midweek in Brisbane, expect a track in the soft/good range, just 7 races on the card. We get underway with a mile & a bit maiden where Moscow Mule is going to start a very warm favourite just as he's done at his pact couple. Both were unlucky defeats & although rising over 300m today the way he's hit the line suggests he'll run it out & the opposition do not look strong at all. Lottery Link the likely quinella/exacta horse.

Tony Gollan trained Veomas a likely improver second-up. Debutante Fracus a market watch.

bestBets.overview: 1350m C1. To my eye sure looks a race of many chances. At the very least no's 1,2,6,10,11 bring speed to it, others do some of the time but not always. HAD IT ALL dug deep to scrape home at the expected juicy price latest. Onya! We shall know by now whether that 'Mule' form-line is worth a cracker or not. LADY WINDERMERE caught the eye fresh, on deeds to date she's on trust 2nd-up. MONAKEED was easy to forgive fresh, this alley is not fair, not at all. SATURDAY'S GIRL finally delivered the goods and deservedly on the day, from this alley this girl may well deliver again. DRAW ATTENTION is new blood resuming for the Gollan camp. If support arrives and they can run on, best to include. ARCTIC WHISPER won well 2nd-up. CAPTIVATE LEGEND and RED SAMOVAR both decent last start winners too. KATIE AINE was a complete forgive latest. Did I mention it looks a deep race?

bestBets.overview: 1680m C2. Waller was good for four now three, my glass remains half-empty. The map says no's 1,6,12 will settle up there. PRECISE STAR has resumed in beaut form, Bella Younberry deservedly up and about after riding her first Saturday metro winner. This will do me. Gollan with one defeating Waller with four. #Braggingrights. #Lessismore. As for the weight of numbers POSSIBILITIES was stiff fresh, at the same time won't be easy from out there for R Maloney. And, the stablemate EMPIRE OF ART didn't get a fair go fresh but it's alley will test Ben Osmond. WOUNDER yet another example of racing a horse where it can win, incredibly took 13 defeats in NSW for the penny to drop, today partakes one for one in Qld. I'm sure the owners wives cheer up when hubby says "honey, we're off to Queensland next start!"

raceTips.comment: Going with Precise Star who has only had the two starts for the Gollan yard winning both. She didn't beat a great deal at the Gold Coast last start however there was plenty to like about the way she went about it & the added distance suits. Possibilities was good fresh & looms as the logical danger. Stormstout was a big run last start, will be decent odds & is worth throwing into exotics.
